priorStatuses.title: Remove the message listener during cleanup

findings.title: [P1] Restore listener removal in the returned cleanup function
findings.body: Calling the disposer no longer unregisters the `"message"` handler. Any long-lived socket with repeated attach/cleanup cycles accumulates handlers, retaining their closures and invoking stale callbacks for every message. This causes unbounded memory/CPU growth and callbacks after teardown.

findings.title: [P1] Remove the message listener during cleanup
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current full diff for src/socket.ts shows attach still registers handler with socket.on("message", handler) but changes the disposer from socket.off("message", handler) to an empty function at added line 3. Cleanup therefore leaves the callback registered, causing post-teardown invocation and accumulation across repeated attach/dispose cycles.
